notes: Salto Grande Dam’s 852 m concrete crossing, nineteen-bay spillway, paired 236 m generating halls, both earthfill wings, yellow crest cranes, and combined international road and rail deck. The main shape, crossing alignment and channel fit use standard PMTiles and the photographed exterior. Exact gate settings, trim and embankment grades are approximate. The model shows the disused rail as static track. Interiors, generating equipment below the turbine deck and the separately planned navigation system are outside this exterior. The deck follows retained map centerlines and approximates the surveyed end grades with standard terrain. Host terrain and water levels can vary.
